format: CSV (comma-delimited text from the bulk ASOS request service)
notes: No model in the repository reads from this source; variables are the full lexicon VOCAB. (earth2studio/lexicon/iem.py IEM_ASOSLexicon.VOCAB, 10 keys).
Stations are IEM identifiers (Des Moines, Chicago O'Hare, Atlanta, San Francisco). report_types and time_tolerance (10 min) are left at the constructor defaults.
The source rate-limits itself to about one request per second (iem.py REQUEST_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 1.1); fg10m is only populated when a gust is reported, so it may be absent from the result.
